note: All sample data is synthetic. Product 'CloudNotes' and all strings are invented for demonstration; no company-internal information.

samples.title_zh: 空译文：设置页三条字符串未翻译
samples.scenario_zh: 供应商交付的德语包里，同步相关文案直接留空，上线后界面会出现英文回退甚至空白按钮。
samples.scenario_en: The German package ships with sync-related strings left blank; production would fall back to English or render empty buttons.

mockLayer2.note_zh: Layer 1 已判定 Error，按设计不再送 LLM（规则不烧 Token，门禁也不放行）。
mockLayer2.note_en: Layer 1 already returned Error; per design the string is not sent to the LLM (rules don't burn tokens; the gate won't pass it anyway).

samples.title_zh: 占位符丢失：目标文少了 {count}
samples.scenario_zh: 源文带 {count} 占位符，法语译文把它翻译成了词组，运行时会显示字面量 {count} 或崩溃。
samples.scenario_en: The source uses {count}; the French target renders it as a word, so runtime shows the literal {count} or crashes.

entries.source: Items in trash are deleted after {days} days
entries.target: Les éléments de la corbeille sont supprimés après {jours} jours

mockLayer2.note_zh: 占位符属于可程序化检查项，Layer 1 拦截后不进入语义层。
mockLayer2.note_en: Placeholder integrity is programmable; after the Layer 1 hit it never reaches the semantic layer.

samples.title_zh: 重复 Key：同一 key 两个不同译文
samples.title_en: Duplicate key: same key, two different targets
samples.scenario_zh: 合并翻译记忆时，settings.sync.title 出现两次且译文不一致，运行时谁生效取决于文件顺序，属于典型合并事故。
samples.scenario_en: A TM merge produced settings.sync.title twice with different targets; which one wins depends on file order — a classic merge accident.

entries.source: Keep your notes up to date

mockLayer2.note_zh: 结构性错误由规则层拦截，LLM 无法替代确定性检查。
mockLayer2.note_en: Structural errors belong to the rules layer; an LLM cannot replace deterministic checks.

samples.title_en: Ambiguous date: is 3/14/26 Mar 14 or the 14th month?
samples.scenario_zh: 西语界面里出现美式短日期，MM/DD 在 DD/MM 习惯的市场会被读反，日程类功能直接产生错误认知。
samples.scenario_en: A US-style short date appears in the Spanish UI; in DD/MM markets users read it backwards — a direct comprehension bug in calendar features.

mockLayer2.note_zh: 日期格式白名单是规则层的典型职责。
mockLayer2.note_en: A date-format allowlist is a textbook rules-layer job.

samples.title_zh: 标点与空格：感叹号前空格、双空格
samples.title_en: Punctuation & spacing: space before !, double spaces
samples.scenario_zh: 法语排版习惯感叹号前加空格，但交付规范要求全语言统一无空格；另有两条混入双空格，属于可修复的排版瑕疵。
samples.scenario_en: French typography adds a space before !, but the style guide mandates none across languages; two strings also carry double spaces — fixable polish issues.

mockLayer2.note_zh: 语义层复核：三条均为排版问题，译义正确，维持 Warning 放行建议。
mockLayer2.note_en: Semantic review: all three are typographic; meaning is correct, so the Warning / pass-with-reason recommendation stands.

samples.title_zh: 省略号不一致：… 与 ... 混用
samples.scenario_zh: 同一版本内省略号风格不统一，规范要求单一省略符 U+2026，混用会在 UI 上产生粗细微差。
samples.scenario_en: Ellipsis style varies within one release; the spec requires U+2026 only — mixing shows subtle weight differences in UI.

mockLayer2.note_zh: 语义层确认译义无误，风格问题建议 Warning + 批量修复。
mockLayer2.note_en: Meaning verified correct; style drift → Warning with a batch-fix suggestion.

samples.title_zh: 长度超限：按钮文案超出 UI 预算 40%
samples.title_en: Length overflow: button label exceeds UI budget by 40%
samples.scenario_zh: 德语按钮文案按经验值超预算，可能截断或挤压相邻控件；需要 UX 确认是缩短文案还是加宽控件。
samples.scenario_en: The German button label exceeds the empirical budget and may truncate or crowd neighbors; UX must decide shorter copy vs wider control.

mockLayer2.note_zh: 语义层：译义正确但确认存在 UI 风险，建议 Warning 并附 UX 复核标记。
mockLayer2.note_en: Meaning is correct but UI risk confirmed; keep Warning and tag for UX review.

samples.title_zh: 术语漂移：同步 = Synch vs Synchronisation 混用
samples.title_en: Terminology drift: Synch vs Synchronisation mixed
samples.scenario_zh: 术语库指定 Sync=Synchronisation，但包内混入 Synch 直译，同一功能两种叫法会直接损伤产品感。
samples.scenario_en: The glossary mandates Sync=Synchronisation, but Synch slips in — two names for one feature damage perceived quality.

mockLayer2.note_zh: 语义层与术语库比对：settings.sync.title 违反术语，其余两条合规。
mockLayer2.note_en: Glossary cross-check: settings.sync.title violates the glossary; the other two comply.

samples.title_zh: 语义错译：Archive 被译成动词「存档动作」
samples.title_en: Semantic error: noun 'Archive' translated as an action verb
samples.scenario_zh: 源文 Archive 是功能页签（名词），日语译成了「アーカイブする」（去归档）这一动作，用户会理解成点按后才会归档。
samples.scenario_en: The source 'Archive' is a noun tab; the Japanese target reads as the action 'archive it', implying tapping archives something.

entries.target: アーカイブはまだ空です

issues.message_zh: 词性错误：源文是名词页签，译文是动词短语（『アーカイブする』= 去归档）。建议改为名词「アーカイブ」。
issues.message_en: Wrong part of speech: source is a noun tab, target is a verb phrase ('アーカイブする' = go archive). Suggest the noun 「アーカイブ」.

mockLayer2.note_zh: 规则层无法判断词性与产品语境，这正是语义层的职责。
mockLayer2.note_en: Rules cannot judge part of speech in product context — exactly the semantic layer's job.

samples.title_zh: 人机仲裁：语气不一致，接受译文并更新风格指南
samples.title_en: Human arbitration: tone mismatch — accept, then update the style guide
samples.scenario_zh: 西语推送文案整体偏正式，与产品「轻快」基调不一致；语义层标为 Warning，人工仲裁接受本版交付，同时把基调条款写进风格指南下一版。
samples.scenario_en: Spanish push copy is formal while the product voice is light; the semantic layer flags Warning. Human arbitration accepts this release and adds a voice clause to the next style guide.

entries.source: Come back and see what's new

issues.message_zh: 译义正确，但使用 usted 正式体（Extrañamos sus notas），与产品轻快基调（tú 体）不一致。
issues.message_en: Meaning is correct, but usted formal register conflicts with the product's light voice (tú).

mockLayer3.reason_zh: 推送已排期，本版接受交付；「营销文案默认 tú 体」写入风格指南 vNext，下一包起按新条款门禁。
mockLayer3.reason_en: Push is already scheduled; ship this release. 'Marketing copy defaults to tú' goes into style guide vNext and gates the next package.
